EPISODE 1, STRIP 01: 森で目覚める。Only PO. Forest dawn, tiny blue flowers and a mossy stone arch persist in backgrounds.

Panel 2 (medium, right-aligned): One brown eye opening at ground level, grass giant at his eye height. PO thought exact: 「寝坊した？」 columns 寝坊した？
Panel 3 (tall borderless reveal): Pochi lying then lifting his RIGHT FOREPAW before his puzzled face. Large readable pads. PO thought exact: 「手が……肉球？」 columns 手が……/肉球？

No human body, no human memory yet, no child or princess. Let surprise develop across these four beats.

Create a NEW PORTRAIT SCROLL STRIP, preferably 1024x2048 or taller; THREE or FOUR unequal sequential panels specified below. This is one segment of a longer episode, not a whole compressed episode. Warm ivory #fffaf3 gutters, crisp anime manga ink, softly luminous cel colors, expressive eyes, clearly legible natural canine anatomy. Different panel heights, selected inset/side-by-side details and borderless emotional shots. Do not impose an equal rectangular grid. Reference images establish IDENTITY and STYLE ONLY; ignore their setting, poses and layouts.
PO: Pochi, compact orange Shiba, cream muzzle/chest/paw socks/eyebrow spots, brown eyes, black nose, naturally curled tail, teal neckerchief, ONE gold five-point star pendant. Natural canine paws, four legs; no human fingers or clothes besides neckerchief. PO inner thoughts use cloud balloons with dots to his head; he NEVER speaks human Japanese aloud. His spoken bark can only be ワン！.
PR: Mira, adult princess, long blonde partly braided hair, blue eyes, silver sapphire tiara, white/royal-blue long gown, blue cloak, simple brown satchel. TO: Toto, seven-year-old brown-haired boy, ochre hooded poncho. GW: natural gray wolf, amber eyes, iron collar. DK: demon king, adult pale male, long black hair, TWO black curved horns, violet eyes, black/purple armor, ONE purple diamond chest jewel. Include ONLY characters explicitly requested for this strip. Keep expressions scene-specific.
INTEGRATED EXACT JAPANESE LETTERING: generate art, balloons, and all supplied Japanese words together. Genuine VERTICAL upright Japanese, top to bottom, columns right to left, not sideways. VERY LARGE printed black manga gothic glyphs 85–95 pixels high at 1024-pixel width, legible when shrunk to 360px. Each balloon max 2–3 columns, max 5–7 glyphs per column. Use the exact given column breaks (slash separates columns, never print slash). Speech tails to speaker's mouth; cloud thoughts with dots to Pochi. Soft voices have light irregular contours, urgent calls sharp contours; don't make every balloon identical. Faces, paws, clues remain uncovered. No speaker labels, episode headings, captions, English, watermarks, extra or duplicated words. Quiet panels truly silent.
Panel flow top to bottom; any paired panels read right to left. At most one short balloon per panel unless explicitly requested. Every panel advances one observed action, discovery, choice or reaction. Preserve stated location and recurring landmark. No future scene/reveal. No copying all reference characters into every panel. ALL lettering must be prominent and occupy generous balloon space. Minimum phone glyph height 22px. Never shrink letters to preserve art; reshape balloons into adjacent background empty space. This is an accessibility requirement. Render letters approximately 1.7x as large as ordinary comic typography. The LAST reference image is the typography benchmark: match its large vertically typeset Japanese glyphs. Do not copy its dog poses or panels.

Panel 3 (larger emotional/action shot): Looks one way toward pond and one toward darker thicket. No dialogue.
Panel 4 (selected close-up or shallow reaction): One forepaw hangs hesitating, face frightened. PO内心 EXACT text: 俺も怖い。. Vertical columns RIGHT TO LEFT: 俺も怖い。.

Create a NEW PORTRAIT SCROLL STRIP, preferably 1024x2048 or taller; THREE or FOUR unequal sequential panels specified below. This is one segment of a longer episode, not a whole compressed episode. Warm ivory #fffaf3 gutters, crisp anime manga ink, softly luminous cel colors, expressive eyes, clearly legible natural canine anatomy. Different panel heights, selected inset/side-by-side details and borderless emotional shots. Do not impose an equal rectangular grid. Reference images establish IDENTITY and STYLE ONLY; ignore their setting, poses and layouts.
PO: Pochi, compact orange Shiba, cream muzzle/chest/paw socks/eyebrow spots, brown eyes, black nose, naturally curled tail, teal neckerchief, ONE gold five-point star pendant. Natural canine paws, four legs; no human fingers or clothes besides neckerchief. PO inner thoughts use cloud balloons with dots to his head; he NEVER speaks human Japanese aloud. His spoken bark can only be ワン！.
PR: Mira, adult princess, long blonde partly braided hair, blue eyes, silver sapphire tiara, white/royal-blue long gown, blue cloak, simple brown satchel. TO: Toto, seven-year-old brown-haired boy, ochre hooded poncho. GW: natural gray wolf, amber eyes, iron collar. DK: demon king, adult pale male, long black hair, TWO black curved horns, violet eyes, black/purple armor, ONE purple diamond chest jewel. Include ONLY characters explicitly requested for this strip. Keep expressions scene-specific.
INTEGRATED EXACT JAPANESE LETTERING: generate art, balloons, and all supplied Japanese words together. Genuine VERTICAL upright Japanese, top to bottom, columns right to left, not sideways. VERY LARGE printed black manga gothic glyphs 85–95 pixels high at 1024-pixel width, legible when shrunk to 360px. Each balloon max 2–3 columns, max 5–7 glyphs per column. Use the exact given column breaks (slash separates columns, never print slash). Speech tails to speaker's mouth; cloud thoughts with dots to Pochi. Soft voices have light irregular contours, urgent calls sharp contours; don't make every balloon identical. Faces, paws, clues remain uncovered. No speaker labels, episode headings, captions, English, watermarks, extra or duplicated words. Quiet panels truly silent.

Every panel advances one observed action, discovery, choice or reaction. Preserve stated location and recurring landmark. No future scene/reveal. No copying all reference characters into every panel. Warm ivory #fffaf3 gutters, crisp anime manga ink, softly luminous cel colors, expressive eyes, clearly legible natural canine anatomy. Different panel heights, selected inset/side-by-side details and borderless emotional shots. Do not impose an equal rectangular grid. Reference images establish IDENTITY and STYLE ONLY; ignore their setting, poses and layouts.
PO: Pochi, compact orange Shiba, cream muzzle/chest/paw socks/eyebrow spots, brown eyes, black nose, naturally curled tail, teal neckerchief, ONE gold five-point star pendant. Natural canine paws, four legs; no human fingers or clothes besides neckerchief. PO inner thoughts use cloud balloons with dots to his head; he NEVER speaks human Japanese aloud. His spoken bark can only be ワン！.
PR: Mira, adult princess, long blonde partly braided hair, blue eyes, silver sapphire tiara, white/royal-blue long gown, blue cloak, simple brown satchel. TO: Toto, seven-year-old brown-haired boy, ochre hooded poncho. GW: natural gray wolf, amber eyes, iron collar. DK: demon king, adult pale male, long black hair, TWO black curved horns, violet eyes, black/purple armor, ONE purple diamond chest jewel. Include ONLY characters explicitly requested for this strip. Keep expressions scene-specific.
INTEGRATED EXACT JAPANESE LETTERING: generate art, balloons, and all supplied Japanese words together. Genuine VERTICAL upright Japanese, top to bottom, columns right to left, not sideways. VERY LARGE printed black manga gothic glyphs 85–95 pixels high at 1024-pixel width, legible when shrunk to 360px. Each balloon max 2–3 columns, max 5–7 glyphs per column. Use the exact given column breaks (slash separates columns, never print slash). Speech tails to speaker's mouth; cloud thoughts with dots to Pochi. Soft voices have light irregular contours, urgent calls sharp contours; don't make every balloon identical. Faces, paws, clues remain uncovered. No speaker labels, episode headings, captions, English, watermarks, extra or duplicated words. Quiet panels truly silent.
Panel flow top to bottom; any paired panels read right to left. At most one short balloon per panel unless explicitly requested. Every panel advances one observed action, discovery, choice or reaction. Preserve stated location and recurring landmark. No future scene/reveal. No copying all reference characters into every panel. ALL lettering must be prominent and occupy generous balloon space. Minimum phone glyph height 22px. Never shrink letters to preserve art; reshape balloons into adjacent background empty space.
